{{Short description|Italian mathematician (1876–1929)}}
'''Carlo Rosati''' ([[Livorno]], 24 April 1876  – [[Pisa]], 19 August 1929) was an Italian [[mathematician]] working on [[algebraic geometry]] who introduced the [[Rosati involution]].<ref>{{Citation | last1=Scorza | first1=G. | title=Carlo Rosati | language=Italian | year=1929 | journal=Periodico | volume=4 | issue=9 | pages= 289–291}}</ref><ref>{{Citation | last1=Scorza | first1=G. | title=L'opera scientifica di C. Rosati | language=Italian | year=1929 | journal=Bollettino di Matematica  | volume=2 | issue=8 | pages=125–127}}</ref>
